title: oliganthes lecomtei
intro: Oliganthes lecomtei, commonly known as Lecomte's Oliganthes, is a plant species within the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine. The health benefits of Oliganthes lecomtei include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, including analgesic and anti-arthritic effects.
